holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Net sales rose to ₹3,080 crore and net profit reached ₹902 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.
A weight loss drug received backing from a European Union panel.
Macquarie named Divi's Laboratories its top Indian pick following Novo's manufacturing pivot into peptide CDMO.

holdings.why_it_matters: Divi's Laboratories is the fund's largest reported position at 5.01% weight and generated an estimated +1.18% contribution over the last 3 months via a 23.47% return, anchoring the 17.2% healthcare exposure.

watch.text: The board meeting scheduled for November 7, 2026 to approve unaudited financial results for Q2FY27.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit reached ₹413 crore on sales of ₹702 crore for the June 2026 period.
The company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named MCX Mineral Exchange of India Limited on October 16, 2026.
Internal leadership transitions took place with new roles assigned for Head of Strategy and Training and Head of Strategic Corporates and Research.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.21% fund weight, MCX added an estimated +0.45% contribution over 3 months on a 10.63% stock gain, providing capital markets diversification within the 22.4% financials basket.

watch.text: The board meeting on November 3, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 increased to ₹17,389 crore, with revenue rising to ₹55,992 crore.
The bank increased fixed deposit interest rates for senior citizens and general depositors up to 7.30%.
The bank announced revisions to select cash transaction charges for savings accounts starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.26% weight, ICICI Bank declined 2.70% over 3 months, offsetting some of the larger drawdowns seen in peer private lenders within the fund's 22.4% financials allocation.

watch.text: Implementation of revised savings account cash transaction charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 rose to ₹21,537 crore from ₹20,383 crore in June 2026.
The bank initiated an internal probe involving two executives regarding leaks of sensitive information.
Shares hovered near 52-week lows ahead of an executive leadership transition.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.85% allocation, HDFC Bank was a top-five detractor over 3 months, posting an estimated -0.19% drag on a -6.73% return.

watch.text: Outcomes of the internal review regarding leaks of sensitive information and the planned CEO handover.

holdings.name: Adani Enterprises Ltd

what_changed.text: The company reported a net loss of ₹1,462 crore in the June 2026 quarter despite sales growing to ₹32,924 crore.
Adani Enterprises signed an MoU with Jabil to set up a 50:50 joint venture for AI and data centre hardware manufacturing in India.
CARE Ratings upgraded the company's long-term credit rating to AA Stable across ₹16,505 crore of facilities.

expected.text: IIFL Capital initiated coverage with a 'Buy' recommendation and projected a 22% upside.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 2.79% weight, the stock was the largest 3-month performance detractor, costing an estimated -0.51% contribution as its price fell 18.15%.

watch.text: The board meeting on October 28, 2026 to review Q2FY27 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales and net profit for the June 2026 quarter were ₹642 crore and ₹148 crore, compared to ₹776 crore and ₹213 crore in March 2026.
The USFDA issued an Establishment Inspection Report and successfully closed the inspection of Unit 3 conducted in August 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Neuland accounts for 2.73% of the portfolio, concentrating the fund's CDMO exposure alongside Divi's Laboratories within the 17.2% healthcare sector.

watch.text: The board meeting on November 3, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY2026 results.

holdings.name: Oil India Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached ₹4,027 crore on revenue of ₹12,503 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.
The company announced a natural gas discovery in the Krishna Godavari Basin flowing 1 to 2 lakh SCUMD and 170 barrels of oil per day.
A revenue sharing contract was signed on October 15, 2026 for Special CBM Block SR-ONHP-(CBM)-2026/1.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.47% fund weight, Oil India forms a key element of the fund's 6.0% Energy & Utilities allocation and posted flat 3-month returns of -0.42%.

watch.text: Further flow evaluation and development milestones from the Krishna Godavari Basin discovery.

holdings.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue rose 51% year-on-year to ₹4,979 crore while net profit declined to ₹534 crore in the quarter ended September 2026.
Executive Director Amal Kelshikar resigned from his role effective October 16, 2026.

expected.text: Nomura maintained a 'Neutral' rating with a target price of ₹4,670 prior to Q2 results.

seeing.text: Reported Q2 net profit fell 10% to ₹534 crore, missing financial expectations despite 51% revenue expansion.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.35% portfolio weight, the stock was among the bottom 3-month contributors, generating an estimated -0.21% drag after an 8.81% share price drop.

watch.text: Management commentary and execution following the departure of Executive Director Amal Kelshikar.

holdings.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd

what_changed.text: Sales volume for Q2FY27 rose 13% year-on-year and 29% quarter-on-quarter to 963,143 tonnes.
June 2026 quarterly net profit stood at ₹263 crore on revenue of ₹5,607 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.16% of fund assets, APL Apollo delivered an estimated +0.25% contribution over 3 months with an 11.57% return, leading the 10.1% industrials allocation.

watch.text: The board meeting on October 26, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year FY2026-27 financial performance.

holdings.name: PTC Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies received an order from Safran for LEAP titanium casting development and entered a long-term production framework agreement.
The company completed a ₹1,800 crore QIP by issuing shares at ₹21,060 each to expand aerospace and defence production.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.15% weight, PTC Industries surged 32.27% over 3 months, adding an estimated +0.69% contribution and ranking as the second-largest driver of fund return.

watch.text: Execution of the Safran LEAP titanium development timeline and deployment of the ₹1,800 crore QIP proceeds.

portfolio.statement: The portfolio delivered -4.33% over 3 months and -9.40% over 1 month, pressured by sharp pullbacks in Adani Enterprises, Adani Transmission, and Avenue Supermarts despite gains in specialty healthcare and aerospace manufacturing.
interp: Top contributors Divi's Laboratories (+1.18% est. contrib) and PTC Industries (+0.69% est. contrib) were outweighed by deep drawdowns in commodity, retail, and utility holdings.
Financials (22.4%) faced a headwind from HDFC Bank's 6.73% 3-month decline amid internal governance probes and senior management changes.
portfolio.line: Healthcare and aerospace strength partially offset broader drag across materials and large-cap lenders.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories rallied 23.47% over 3 months supported by European panel backing for a weight loss drug and peptide CDMO tailwinds.
PTC Industries gained 32.27% over 3 months after securing a Safran aerospace casting contract and raising ₹1,800 crore via QIP.
Adani Enterprises declined 18.15% over 3 months following a reported net loss in the June 2026 quarter.
HDFC Bank fell 6.73% over 3 months amid an internal probe into sensitive information leaks.

themes.title: Specialty Pharma and CDMO
themes.text: Substantial portfolio concentration in contract development and manufacturing, benefiting from global regulatory clearances and peptide production trends.

themes.title: Aerospace & Industrial Manufacturing
themes.text: Exposure to critical titanium castings and structural tubes supported by order wins and rising sales volumes.

macro.why: New hydrocarbon finds and coal-bed methane blocks affect domestic production volumes and realization schedules.
FD rate hikes to attract retail deposits and governance oversight influence private sector banking spreads.

priced_in.text: PTC Industries' capital increase through an ₹1,800 crore QIP at ₹21,060 per share reflecting its order pipeline with Safran.
Strong volume expansion for APL Apollo Tubes after reaching record Q2 sales volume of 963,143 tonnes.

could_change.text: Commercialization of the 50:50 hardware JV with Jabil could reverse recent operating losses.

could_change.text: Completion of the CEO leadership transition and closure of internal information leak investigations could stabilize share price pressure.
